original_ai_output.title_zh: 乍得警告反对边境入侵，同时收容逾两百万流离失所者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 乍得在联合国大会第81届会议上重申对地区和平的承诺，并强调在苏丹冲突中保持严格中立，同时警告任何侵犯其国家主权的行为。自2023年4月以来，已有超过一百万苏丹人越境进入乍得东部，乍得目前收容逾两百万被迫流离失所者。乍得政府以最强烈措辞谴责与苏丹冲突有关的、发生在Ennedi Est省的近期空袭，称其为不可接受的侵犯，并警告若此类事件再次发生将保留采取一切必要措施的权利。

location.raw_text: Ennedi Est province; Chad's eastern borders

key_facts.fact: 乍得在联合国大会上警告反对任何侵犯其国家主权的行为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Chad has reaffirmed its commitment to regional stability from the rostrum of the United Nations General Assembly at its 81st session... issuing a firm warning against any violations of its national sovereignty.

key_facts.fact: 自2023年4月以来超过一百万苏丹人越境进入乍得东部
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Since April 2023, more than one million Sudanese have crossed Chad's eastern borders fleeing conflict.

key_facts.fact: 乍得目前收容逾两百万被迫流离失所者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: N'Djamena now hosts over two million forcibly displaced individuals, translating to approximately one in every seventeen residents.

key_facts.fact: 乍得政府以最强烈措辞谴责与苏丹冲突有关的Ennedi Est省近期空袭
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The government condemned "in the strongest terms" recent airstrikes in the Ennedi Est province directly linked to the Sudanese conflict.

key_facts.fact: 乍得警告若此类侵犯再次发生将保留采取一切必要措施的权利
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: N'Djamena warned that it reserves the right to take all necessary measures under international law should such incidents recur.

uncertainties: 事件为单一来源报道（Alwihda Info），尚缺乏交叉验证
空袭的具体实施方未在报道中明确说明
